summary.text: The champion earns Warmaster recognition and uncovers the truth: the Hollow Regent is Edras Veyr, founder of the Veil Watch and author of the current war.

chapter.progressionIntent: The long progression toward level 50, Warzone points, and Warmaster gear remains meaningful and party-oriented.

summary.text: Complete the realm's High Sky trial, earn Warmaster recognition, and recover Edras Veyr's unaltered confession.

text.text: Enter the realm-specific High Sky trial.
Complete its combat and support contribution requirements.
Break the false archive seal without destroying the record.
Hear Edras Veyr's original rejected wish.
Bring the confession to Valerius and the realm council.

summary.text: Confront guardians of the first floating fortress and reject the idea that endurance excuses tyranny.
Navigate magical storms and prove harmony includes voices that disagree.
Prove to the Sky Wardens that public faith cannot be owned by a crown.
Infiltrate the light-fortress and reveal the darkness hidden inside its perfect order.

choice.meaning: Choose whether Valerius hears the confession privately first or beside the council; his responsibility remains acknowledged either way.

mainQuest.completionOutcome: The Hollow Regent's identity and motive become known, Warmaster progression receives narrative purpose, and the eight-gem race becomes an emergency rather than a treasure hunt.

summary.text: Recover the names of Veil Watch officers who opposed Edras and were erased from the official founding record.

mainStoryContribution.text: Prevents the Veil Watch from being reduced to either spotless heroes or secret villains and gives Valerius a credible path to reform it.

text.text: Verify their signatures against field records.
Restore the names to the Watch roll.
The reformed Veil Watch memorializes the dissenters and adopts their anti-coercion oath.

summary.text: Help a healer, buffer, or defender prove contribution in a trial designed around visible finishing blows.

mainStoryContribution.text: Reinforces the game's support-role promise and explains why Warmaster recognition measures meaningful contribution rather than kill count alone.

text.text: Demonstrate healing, buffing, protection, or control under pressure.
Warmaster contribution explanations become clearer; no points or eligibility are granted by the side quest.
